BasicAuthConfig.description: Plugin: basic_auth — HTTP Basic credentials verified against HMAC-SHA256 password hashes. The property set is CLOSED: `null` and an empty object both select the defaults, and no other key is accepted. (The enclosing PluginConfig `config` property is independently restricted to objects, so `null` is only reachable when this component is validated on its own.)

hide_credentials.description: Remove the `Authorization` field carrying the RFC 7617 `Basic` scheme before forwarding an authenticated request upstream, including when another mechanism wins a multi-auth chain and this credential merely rode along. Basic encodes a reusable password in reversible Base64, so it is removed by default. Only the `Basic` scheme is removed; a `Bearer` or other scheme another policy needs is left in place. Disable only when a legacy backend explicitly requires the reusable credential. A request that sends more than one `Authorization` credential (repeated field lines, or a second credential after a top-level comma) never reaches this plugin: the ingress protocol guard rejects it with 400 on every protocol.
